Designing interactive processes for high-dimensional data analysis that incorporate progressive and interactive computations is a key factor to support users in their analysis tasks.
progressive and interactive methods can be incorporated into high-dimensional data analysis processes to support analysts in achieving their analysis goals.

the following questions: (1) how can progressive and interactive processes be combined to enable high-dimensional data analysis? In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the design of interactive data analysis processes should be informed by the characteristics of the data and the users, and should incorporate progressive computations where applicable.
progressive computations can be incorporated into interactive analysis sessions to improve the overall experience and productivity of the analysts.
progressive methods can be incorporated within interactive visual analytics processes to facilitate the analysis of high-dimensional data.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the progressive and interactive analysis of high-dimensional data can be achieved by using online algorithms to progressively compute the results of the analysis process, while at the same time, the analysts can interact with the system and influence the computation.
we have provided an approach to incorporate progressive methods for interactive high-dimensional data analysis.

we provide design recommendations and methods that can be used to facilitate interactive analysis processes involving high-dimensional data, and that we provide evidence that our approach contributes to the efficiency and effectiveness of such processes.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the design of interactive analysis processes should consider the characteristics of progressive methods, and that the design of progressive algorithms should take into account the characteristics of the human-computer interaction.

the design of interactive visual analysis processes for high-dimensional data analysis should incorporate the following: (i) progressive algorithms, (ii) perceptual considerations, (iii) user interaction, and (iv) a set of design guidelines.
the progressive and interactive nature of the analysis process can be supported by progressive computations, which in turn can improve the productivity and efficiency of analysts.
